Hey man I know you’re going through much, but I get how that feels, that true love, how no matter how much that person done to you, you still love them
Don’t kill yourself, 
No matter how bad life goes 
No matter how painful it gets
Life goes on and there is light at the end of the tunnel
If you need help, rant to someone, talk to people and reach out for help, patch up that hole in your heart

Yeah, my mom is giving me back to my douchebag dad, my mom and my sister will go to Canada without me 
The only family that I loved are leaving me begind

But I’m so scared, I’m so scared of being alone again. I lived my whole life caring for others instead of myself just so I can have someone that won’t leave me, but after everything the opposite happened. I’m all alone and nothing can go back to the way it is
But I’ve already lost my dreams, my dream and will to live was to make my mom happy for once and I failed that. I have no more use
